title: 3 Days 2 Nights Tour in New York
includes: 2 Nights Hotel---One booking for One Hotel Room
Admission-- Liberty Cruise/One World Trade Center/Mdm. Tussauds/Intrepid Museum (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation:
If you cancel at least 6 full day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a full refund.
If you cancel between 2 and 6 day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a 50% refund.
If you cancel within 2 day(s) of the scheduled departure, you will receive a 0% refund.
blurb:
Tour package with a tour guide visits one of the biggest cities in the world in 3 days(2 nights). The Hotel is included. The tour is very well organized. The itinerary is very nice and effective. The tour guide can help you during the tour.
You can visit Times Square, Rockefeller Centre, Intrepid Sea-Air-Space Museum, Ripley’s Believe It or Not, Mdm. Tussauds, World Trade Center memorial museum, Manhattan, 5th Ave., Wall Street..., You can take a cruise to see Statue of Liberty. You can see Trump Tower, Empire Building... You also can make shopping at Woodbury Outlets Mall.
